lastCommit.subject: Rename app to Ipelege throughout docs; save session handoff

current.summary: Imported the Claude Design system into the repo, then closed the specification gaps the import exposed. Eight new documents (design-system, design-deltas, database, admin, cancellation, safety, components, test-strategy) and eleven revised. Backend, admin, routing and hosting decided. Coding deferred to next session by user direction.
current.state: pre-build; 29 specification documents plus a parked Flutter scaffold
decisions: Backend: Django 5 + DRF + GeoDjango on PostgreSQL 16 + PostGIS
Admin: Django admin in the same project, built alongside each feature it unblocks - not a separate app, not Flutter Web
Routing: Valhalla, not OSRM - ghcr.io/gis-ops/docker-valhalla publishes linux/arm64; osrm/osrm-backend Docker Hub images are amd64-only and last published July 2021
Nine launch categories, not six - small trades split into plumbing, electrical, tiling; catering separated from hire
Hosting: self-managed VPS for root access the append-only ledger requires; Oracle Always Free ARM for phase 0, Botswana-resident for production
Auth phased: email+password+phone+names via django-allauth now, SMS OTP when an aggregator is affordable; phone unique from day one
Safety model is traceability not prevention - record who/where/when and make reporting fast
working: Design imported: tokens, type scale, motion, navigation, screen inventory in docs/design-system.md
OKLCH to sRGB conversion done accurately; app/lib/theme/tokens.dart holds the full palette as an AppPalette ThemeExtension
Flutter 3.41.6 / Dart 3.11.4 verified; project bw.co.ipelege created with go_router, flutter_riverpod, intl, decimal
Documentation set internally consistent and cross-linked
notWorking: No application code - app/lib/main.dart is the generated stub
Design HTML archive truncated at 256 KiB - eight specification tables lost including backRules, navState, haptics, loadingStates, savedStates, motionSpecs
18 brand PNGs not in repo - live only in the design project
Hosting not provisioned - user creating Oracle account, will supply SSH
doNotRepeat: DesignSync get_file has a hard 256 KiB cap with no offset parameter - retrying returns the same truncation
Pulling binary assets via get_file costs ~35k tokens per PNG - download from the design project in a browser instead
Blog posts and GitHub issue pages gave contradictory answers on OSRM ARM support - query the Docker Hub and GHCR registry manifests directly
git add --dry-run output is filtered to nothing by the rtk hook - use git ls-files --others --exclude-standard or stage then inspect git diff --staged --stat
bc is not installed in this Git Bash environment
nextSteps: Build the Flutter shell: motion.dart, typography.dart, app_theme.dart, Money formatter (Pula, explicit, never device locale)
Navigation: go_router with two bottom-nav shells, per-tab stacks, push/lateral/replace rules
Wire main.dart to the theme with Light/Dark/System, replacing the stub
Take SSH from user and provision Oracle box - Docker Compose with Postgres 16 + PostGIS, Redis, MinIO, Caddy, all arm64-native
Recover the eight truncated design tables from Claude Design, backRules especially
Get a hosting quote from Digital Delta DC1 (BoFiNet, Block 8)
Remaining specs: offline and connectivity, API contract shape, environments and CI, observability, refresh CONTRIBUTING.md
blockers: What the verified badge stands behind - admin saw a trade certificate, customers read safe to let into my home. Raise the check or lower the claim. Biggest open item.
LEDGER_ACCOUNT: one per provider or one per provider per category - blocks the ledger schema
Dispute window and full-trail retention are one decision, not two - the window must be shorter
The wallet naming contradicts a binding constraint in compliance.md - goes to counsel with the EPS question
What happens to already-accepted bookings when a category is revoked - blocks the revocation screen and safety suspension
Data residency - external, now narrower: local Tier III capacity confirmed, only the price is missing
